description: The icon sets an OPF `icon` names as `<set>:<name>` (LH-14). Each record holds a set's license, copyright, version, source, its one viewBox and style, and every icon as SVG path data with its search tags; written by scripts/build-icon-sets.mjs from the pinned npm packages, never by hand. A host loads a set only when a deck uses it (`gallery.iconSets`).

records.summary: Clean, consistent outline icons on a 24 px grid with 2 px strokes; the default set.
